$comment: How Slack's hosted MCP server wraps the answers of its tools, as the host's executor hands them to the plugin: slack_read_user_profile and slack_list_user_channels answer { result: <Markdown> } as output, and the same object as one line of JSON in the content text; slack_read_channel answers { messages, pagination_info }. Shapes recorded 2026-11-20; every value is invented, the user is the placeholder U00CURRENTUSER. A change of wrapper must fail test/unit/answer-shapes.test.ts, not a source binding.
